_description: Reusable AI image generation prompt template. Replace values in the 'subject' section to generate different people while keeping consistent quality settings.
_usage: Copy this template, modify the 'subject' block for your specific person, then combine all sections into a single prompt string using the 'build_prompt()' helper or by concatenating the values.

subject.body_type: athletic and curvaceous figure, toned physique
subject.attire: black high-waisted yoga pants, fitted athletic crop top
subject.hair: long voluminous brunette hair with subtle highlights, natural movement
subject.skin: natural warm skin tone, visible skin texture with subtle pores, natural subsurface scattering, no airbrushing
subject.eyes: bright expressive eyes with natural catchlight reflections, visible iris detail and limbal ring, natural eyelashes
subject.face: symmetrical facial features, natural makeup with soft contour, defined cheekbones, full lips with natural color
subject.expression: confident and approachable smile, natural and relaxed
subject.pose: confident standing pose, slight hip shift, one hand on hip

realism_details.skin_realism: micro skin texture with fine pores visible, natural skin imperfections, subtle peach fuzz, realistic light interaction on skin surface
realism_details.eye_realism: detailed iris with natural color variation, visible blood vessels in sclera, natural tear film reflection, pupil dilation consistent with lighting
realism_details.hair_realism: individual hair strand detail, natural flyaway hairs, realistic light transmission through hair edges, subtle scalp visibility at part line
realism_details.body_realism: anatomically correct proportions, natural muscle definition under skin, realistic joint articulation, natural body curvature and weight distribution
realism_details.fabric_realism: visible fabric weave texture, natural fabric stretch and compression, realistic wrinkle patterns at joints, proper light absorption on matte fabrics

lighting.key_light: large softbox key light at 45 degrees camera-right, soft diffused illumination
lighting.fill_light: reflector fill light camera-left reducing shadow contrast ratio to 2:1
lighting.rim_light: warm-toned hair light from above and behind for edge separation
lighting.ambient: controlled studio ambient, no environmental spill light
lighting.color_temperature: 5500K daylight-balanced key, slight warm shift on rim

camera.body: Canon EOS R5 or equivalent full-frame mirrorless
camera.aperture: f/2.8 for subject isolation with background separation
camera.iso: ISO 100 for maximum detail and minimum noise
camera.focus: eye-detect autofocus locked on nearest eye, tack-sharp
camera.distance: shot from 8 feet, three-quarter body framing

environment.background: clean seamless studio backdrop, neutral gray or soft gradient
environment.floor: light-toned studio floor with subtle reflection
environment.atmosphere: clean studio air, no haze or particles

post_processing.resolution: 8K ultra high resolution, maximum detail retention
post_processing.color_grade: natural color science, accurate skin tone reproduction, no oversaturation
post_processing.sharpening: subtle capture sharpening, no over-sharpening artifacts
post_processing.noise: clean image, grain-free, ISO 100 noise floor
post_processing.dynamic_range: full dynamic range preserved in highlights and shadows

Micro skin texture with fine pores visible, natural skin imperfections, subtle peach fuzz, individual hair strand detail with natural flyaway hairs, anatomically correct proportions, visible fabric weave texture with natural stretch patterns.
